title: Noise preserves nonnegativity
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $0\le\rho\le1$, and let $f\colon\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ satisfy $f(x)\ge0$ at every point $x$. Then $T_\rho f(x)\ge0$ at every point of the cube.
replaced: Let $0\le\rho\le1$ and $f:\{0,1\}^n\to[0,\infty)$. Then $T_\rho f(x)\ge0$ at every cube point $x$. For $d\in\mathbb N$, $h:\{0,1\}^d\to\bbr$, and $\tau\in\bbr$, the spectral noise operator is $T_\tau h(x)=\sum_{S\subseteq[d]}\tau^{|S|}\widehat h(S)\chi_S(x)$, where $\chi_S(x)=(-1)^{\sum_{i\in S}x_i}$ and $\widehat h(S)=\E[h\chi_S]$ under the uniform measure.
